booking_target.name: booking_target
booking_target.value: (target_type='vehicle' AND target_vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND target_model_id IS NULL AND target_brand_id IS NULL AND target_group_id IS NULL) OR (target_type='model' AND target_model_id IS NOT NULL AND target_vehicle_id IS NULL AND target_brand_id IS NULL AND target_group_id IS NULL) OR (target_type='brand' AND target_brand_id IS NOT NULL AND target_vehicle_id IS NULL AND target_model_id IS NULL AND target_group_id IS NULL) OR (target_type='equivalence_group' AND target_group_id IS NOT NULL AND target_vehicle_id IS NULL AND target_model_id IS NULL AND target_brand_id IS NULL)

finance_allocation_bucket.name: finance_allocation_bucket
finance_allocation_bucket.value: (bucket='credit' AND booking_id IS NULL) OR (bucket IN ('rent','deposit') AND booking_id IS NOT NULL)

pricing_quote_confirmation.name: pricing_quote_confirmation
pricing_quote_confirmation.value: (confirmed_at IS NULL AND confirmed_by IS NULL AND confirmed_overrides IS NULL AND version=1) OR (confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND confirmed_overrides IS NOT NULL AND version=2)

one_current_assignment.name: one_current_assignment
one_current_assignment.where: retired_at IS NULL AND booking_id IS NOT NULL

schedule_source.name: schedule_source
schedule_source.value: (kind='assignment' AND booking_id IS NOT NULL) OR (kind='technical' AND booking_id IS NULL)

vehicle_transmission.name: vehicle_transmission
vehicle_transmission.value: transmission IS NULL OR transmission IN ('automatic','manual')

vehicle_mileage.name: vehicle_mileage
vehicle_mileage.value: (current_mileage_km IS NULL OR current_mileage_km>=0) AND (next_maintenance_due_km IS NULL OR next_maintenance_due_km>=0)

checkout_stop_before_issue.name: checkout_stop_before_issue
checkout_stop_before_issue.value: stopped_at IS NULL OR issued_at IS NULL

contract_version_status.name: contract_version_status
contract_version_status.value: status IN ('pending','ready','failed') AND (status='ready') = (file_id IS NOT NULL) AND revision > 0

act_status.name: act_status
act_status.value: status IN ('pending','ready','failed') AND (status='ready') = (file_id IS NOT NULL)

inspection_values.name: inspection_values
inspection_values.value: kind IN ('pickup','check_in') AND mileage_km >= 0 AND fuel_eighths BETWEEN 0 AND 8 AND revision > 0

private_file_owner.name: private_file_owner
private_file_owner.value:
(category IN ('inspection_photo','contract','inspection_act') AND booking_id IS NOT NULL AND customer_id IS NULL)
    OR (category = 'customer_document' AND customer_id IS NOT NULL AND booking_id IS NULL)

private_file_photo_context.name: private_file_photo_context
private_file_photo_context.value: (category = 'inspection_photo' AND vehicle_id IS NOT NULL AND inspection_kind IS NOT NULL AND inspection_kind IN ('pickup','check_in')) OR (category <> 'inspection_photo' AND vehicle_id IS NULL AND inspection_kind IS NULL)

private_file_expiration.name: private_file_expiration
private_file_expiration.value: category = 'inspection_photo' OR (delete_after IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL)

private_file_metadata.name: private_file_metadata
private_file_metadata.value: size > 0 AND checksum ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND mime IN ('image/png','image/jpeg','application/pdf')
